lesson.uz:
and ikkala shart bajarilishini talab qiladi; or kamida bittasini; not esa natijani teskarilaydi. (age >= 12) and (age <= 17) — yopiq oraliq.
Qavslar ma’noni aniqlashtiradi. Ruxsat uchun ikki talab bo‘lsa and, ikki muqobil yo‘l bo‘lsa or ishlating. True va False o‘rniga shartda ko‘rsatilgan YES/NO yoki sonni chiqaring.
lesson.en:
and requires both conditions, or at least one, and not reverses a condition. (age >= 12) and (age <= 17) describes an inclusive interval.
Use parentheses for clarity. Use and for two requirements and or for alternatives. Print the requested YES/NO or number rather than an unspecified Boolean.
